title: Paint
author: @lunokjod
description: A page to draw with a finger, and the ink waits for the hand to go: the glass is sampled while the finger moves and nothing is painted until it has been still for two and a half seconds —an e-ink panel is not a canvas that follows a finger—. The tools are a brush with its thickness and a bucket, and the palette is the sixteen tones the panel has. A drawing is saved as ICS1, the cheapest picture of this system (four bits a pixel, the same file a thumbnail is made of), and Export writes an eight-bit PGM that any other page here can open. The extension it claims is .ics, and a drawing opened from Files comes back to this page.
